what_happened: The task's creation-time file_scope declares 5 paths but a mechanical grep of the source store found ~50 files referencing the surface, including four live code paths the description does not enumerate: the engine-written-state staging allowlist in scripts/lib/engine-written-state-paths-lib.sh, measure-eager-context.sh's VOLATILE_PATHS deny-list, hooks/events-log-artifact.sh's case branch, and orchestrator-postflight.sh's error_ref cross-link. The plan widens to 8 phases accordingly; file_scope will be widened by plan-file-scope-harvest.sh rather than by the creation-time declaration.

validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification under-verification check caught three phases whose hand-picked run-all.sh --only lists were narrower than what the repository's own suite_selection_select resolves for the same touched paths. The warning named the exact missing suites, turning a guess into a mechanical correction: two phases now compose suite_selection_select into --only, and one was honestly raised to full because it edits scripts/lib/common.sh, a surface every suite sources.

Phase 2's own verification grep (errors-append|errors-format|errors-schema over manifest.json/index-entries.json) caught an unlisted match: the standards/error-recovery-strategies.md index entry's summary and keywords named errors-append.sh even though that path was not in Phase 2's enumerated edit list. Corrected it in Phase 2 (retargeted to issue-record.sh wording) to satisfy the phase's own stated check and pre-empt Phase 5's planned content retarget of the same underlying file.
